description: SimGEM vs the CERN GDD single-GEM current-mode gains (D. Janssens, CERN summer student report 2019): CERN standard double-mask GEM (70/50 um holes), Ar:CO2 70:30, 1 atm, E_D = 2, E_I = 3 kV/cm, drift 3 mm, induction 2 mm (GEM2 of a triple used as anode). Measured G_eff = exp(0.02162 V - 4.503) after charging-up (x1.43 above the uncharged foil); their Garfield++ (ANSYS, r = 0.56) is 2.25 +- 0.26 below it.
